_about: Written by us after testing each app version. format: this version's build format. releases: for a build made with an earlier format, what the app tells the player: not needed / recommended / mandatory, with a one-line reason. The app also compares the build's recorded shader chain version and pack format with its own: a build this game program cannot load is mandatory whatever this table says (the table can raise that, never lower it).
estimate: about 15-30 minutes until you can play with Quick start; the rest compiles in the background

1.note: The shaders are now one library file and the compile cache one database (nxnative's storage), instead of millions of small files: safer, smaller and faster to build.

2.note: The shaders now use nxnative's own storage (one library file and one cache database) instead of this app's earlier pack files; builds are also about a third faster.
